reviews.title: Best Buy! Value for money.  Really good pc case
reviews.comment:
Excellent build quality. Very easy to work with. Building with this case is easy. Lots of space for cable management. Can handle long gpu. 

Comes with 2 white fans. Only cons that I can see is the psu is mounted with fan on top. But that is not an issue for me but maybe an issue with other people.
